title: Alphawaves dataset
description: The Alphawaves dataset comprises resting-state EEG recordings from 19 healthy participants acquired using a 16-channel g.tec g.USBamp system at 512 Hz sampling rate. Participants alternated between eyes-closed and eyes-open conditions in 10-second trials, with data annotated using HED 8.4.0 schema. This dataset is designed for benchmarking brain-computer interface algorithms and studying alpha oscillatory activity during different resting states.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded from 19 healthy subjects (mean age 25.8 years) using a 16-channel g.tec g.USBamp amplifier with wet electrodes at a sampling rate of 512 Hz. The standard 10-10 montage was used with right earlobe reference. Subjects performed a resting-state paradigm alternating between eyes-closed and eyes-open conditions, with each trial lasting 10 seconds. Data were acquired using OpenViBE software with a 50 Hz line frequency and no online digital filtering applied.
